summary: AudioCodes Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 14, 2026 disclosing adoption of a Rule 10b5-1 stock trading plan to repurchase ordinary shares during periods when insider-trading laws or self-imposed blackouts would otherwise bar buybacks. An independent broker selected by the Company holds authority to execute repurchases under specified pricing parameters, subject to Rule 10b-18 price, volume and timing constraints. No share count, dollar authorization, price per share, premium or expiration date was stated. Watch actual repurchase pacing, cash usage and any concurrent Israeli corporate-law buyback approvals as signals of capital-return intensity.
